question: Should the initial bundled xAI Talk provider expose provider-managed session resumption as a default-off configuration option?
rationale: This changes provider disconnect behavior and conversation replay or retention semantics, creating a permanent user-facing configuration contract that cannot be selected by code review alone.

options.title: Ship default-off opt-in
options.body: Keep `sessionResumption` explicit and disabled by default, document its continuity and retention implications, and prove both modes on the rebased head.

options.title: Defer resumption
options.body: Remove the option from this PR, keep disconnects fail-closed, and add resumption later through a separately approved provider change.

options.title: Pause provider launch
options.body: Hold the complete provider while maintainers choose the canonical transport, reconnect, and retention policy across the overlapping implementations.

recommendation.title: Ship default-off opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep `sessionResumption` explicit and disabled by default, document its continuity and retention implications, and prove both modes on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available adjacent history across xAI provider behavior, Talk gateway work, and prior live-voice product discussion.
